summary: Inception Growth Acquisition Ltd, a SPAC, filed an 8-K on June 11, 2026, reporting a $12,203.33 deposit into its trust account to extend the deadline to complete a business combination from June 13, 2026, to July 13, 2026. The extension provides additional time to find and close a deal. No price, premium, or advisor details are involved. The filing is a routine SPAC extension, typical of blank-check companies, and the registrant is the SPAC issuer. Watch for a potential business combination announcement before July 13, 2026.
